title: Target environment
summary: A case's target_envs names registered environments; [] keeps the plan default. Cases select registered environments without a production-role restriction or a required stage_reason. Optional stage_reason metadata does not choose the target. Each target creates its own delivery obligation. A control plane whose own environment declares qa.restrict_execution_to_self (Yoke's hosted Stage and Production) runs only cases that target that environment; there a standalone plan run targeting another environment refuses with cannot execute QA target and teaches running from the target's control plane or a deployment QA stage that targets it.
